pathAssistantSteps.info:
Assigned - breaker is assigned to a Quote or Opportunity.

  • Soft hold for the linked deal
  • If the deal falls through, return to Available

Available - breaker/port is unallocated and ready for assignment.

  • Confirm capacity type (Power Circuit/Cross Connect Port) and kW rating
  • Unit is visible in feasibility checks for new Opportunities

Installed - circuit is live and energized.

  • Customer has active power feed
  • Monitor for capacity changes and contract renewal

Pending Available - breaker is transitioning back to the available pool.

  • Previous allocation ended or circuit was released
  • Ops to verify circuit is physically cleared before marking Available

ROFR - Right of First Refusal active.

  • Existing customer has contractual right to this breaker
  • Cannot sell without offering to ROFR holder first

Reserved - Order confirmed, awaiting provisioning.

  • Breaker is hard-allocated to the Order
  • Ops to schedule electrical provisioning

Sold - breaker is contractually committed.

  • Linked to an Order Item
  • Service Commencement Date set
  • Customer billing begins on SCD

Stranded - breaker cannot be allocated in current state.

  • Electrical or infrastructure issue prevents allocation
  • Ops to investigate and resolve before returning to Available
